You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, design, and go-to-market, shaping how AI agents discover, retrieve, and act on web information in real time. We are looking for someone who can operate as a senior strategic partner, not just an executor, and who has the potential to grow into a principal-level PM over time. You’re welcome to  work hybrid from Tel Aviv, Israel. Your responsibilities will include:   Own a core product area end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, execution, and iteration based on real usage signals and customer feedback. Drive search quality and relevance improvements by working closely with engineering and research to define evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and release criteria. Engage directly with enterprise customers and developer users to validate ideas, understand pain points, and shape product-market fit across both PLG and enterprise motions. Monitor the competitive landscape in agentic search and AI-powered retrieval, identifying shifts, threats, and opportunities that should inform product decisions. Collaborate with go-to-market teams (sales, solutions, growth) to ensure product positioning, ICP definitions, and enablement materials reflect product reality. jobs.title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
jobs.description: UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group. We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy. You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short. What you will do: Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them. Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first. Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path. Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work. Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von KI, Sprache und Pädagogik, mit echten Familien statt Laborbedingungen und mit direktem Draht ins Produkt. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Buyer
jobs.description: Brief info about Vinted  Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we re looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania s first unicorn! jobs.description: About Team & About Role Rubrik helps organisations in every major industry stay resilient against cyberattacks, insider threats and operational disruption, protecting the data that hospitals, banks and public institutions depend on every day. As Territory Account Executive in Southern Germany, you’ll build business in one of Europe’s strongest industrial and financial regions, with large companies and ambitious Mittelstand firms on your doorstep. You’ll join a close-knit German team that shares deal strategy openly, backed by regional marketing, events and partner support to help you open doors. Run multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end with MEDDPICC: find the budget owner, build champions and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk. jobs.title: Account Executive, Named - Germany
jobs.description: About Team & About Role Rubrik s sales organisation is a unified group of elite cross-functional professionals helping companies across every major industry achieve true resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. As Named Account Executive in Germany, you ll own a portfolio of large enterprise accounts, driving Rubrik s continued expansion in one of Europe s most dynamic enterprise markets. What You ll Do Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts across Germany, combining existing customer relationships with new business development. Run full, multistakeholder sales cycles end to end — from discovery and qualification through solution design, negotiation, and close — across both net-new logo and existing-account expansion deals. Build and manage a high-quality pipeline across your territory, balancing larger strategic opportunities with faster-moving transactional deals. Develop executive relationships within your accounts, translating Rubrik s technical capabilities into the board-level priorities that make data security a strategic imperative. Partner closely with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development, and Rubrik s partner ecosystem to extend reach across your territory and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk. Collaborate with and learn from your regional peers — the German team works closely together on deal strategy and account coverage, so you ll grow fastest by leaning on each other. Feed market intelligence back to Rubrik s leadership, including competitive signals and account trends that shape our go-to-market approach across Germany. Experience You ll Need Experience closing complex enterprise deals, with the appetite to grow into larger, multi-product opportunities — we ll help you build the rest. jobs.description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. jobs.description: Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix. At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires. I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves. Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week. That means a strong engineering manager who can still ship. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works. You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. jobs.description: 🤓 About Luminovo At Luminovo , we’re building the infrastructure that turns the electronics supply chain into something software can read and act on. Our customers use it to quote PCBAs faster, find cost savings and act on risks in their supply chain. We serve 300+ customers, from Europe’s largest EMS to category-leading OEMs, with around 100 Luminerds across Munich, Berlin, New York and Austin. We’re backed by Chalfen Ventures, Cherry Ventures and General Catalyst. With data centers and robotics driving demand for electronics, someone needs to manage that supply chain, and they’ll need good software to do it. ( Here’s why we care so much about electronics .) 🚀 Your role Team Core is our platform team. Its job is to make all our other engineering teams more productive and to improve our codebase and infrastructure as a whole. You’ll: Keep our DevOps setup and CI/CD pipelines fast and reliable Build tools every team needs (e.g. interface for building permissions) Act as an in-house Rust expert: our backend is a Rust monolith, and Team Core helps the other teams use good Rust patterns and architecture Be responsible for the Developer Experience (DX). Help our engineers use agents more productively Other details Location: remote-first, within two hours of CET. We prefer Munich > Berlin > Germany > Europe. Tech stack: Rust, TypeScript + React, Postgres, Clickhouse, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, Helm, Flux 🇺🇸 Some of the work in this role falls under US export control regulations (ITAR), so you must be a US citizen . You’ll need to be based in Europe, and if you’re currently in the US, we’ll support your relocation to Germany. 🖲️ Our tech stack We always try to use the best tools available for the job. Don't worry, we don't need you to be familiar with all of these: Main monolith is written in Rust (using actix-web as our web framework), deployed on Kubernetes React and Typescript for frontend PostgreSQL for persisting our data Redis for caching and queues Flux for GitO

jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France. Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals). You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers. jobs.description: L'Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, elle contribue à sécuriser les échanges de données de santé, à développer l'interopérabilité et à promouvoir des services numériques au bénéfice des professionnels et des usagers. Au cœur de ces enjeux, Pro Santé Connect (PSC) est le service de fédération d'identité du secteur de la santé. Il permet aux professionnels d'accéder de manière sécurisée aux services numériques de santé grâce à une authentification adaptée à leurs besoins. Pour accompagner le développement de cet écosystème, l'ANS développe l' Espace de confiance Pro Santé Connect (EDC PSC) . Ce dispositif vise à permettre aux solutions numériques en santé de se raccorder à Pro Santé Connect et à leurs utilisateurs d'accéder aux services numériques dans des conditions maîtrisées de sécurité et de confiance. Il repose sur plusieurs dimensions complémentaires : interopérabilité technique, exigences de sécurité, référencement, qualification, accompagnement des acteurs et surveillance dans la durée. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable de projet transverse , chargé(e) de porter la vision globale de l'Espace de confiance et d'en coordonner le développement et le fonctionnement. 🎯 Vos missions En tant que Responsable de projet transverse, vous êtes garant(e) de la cohérence globale de l'Espace de confiance Pro Santé Connect. Vous définissez sa trajectoire, coordonnez les différentes expertises mobilisées et veillez au bon fonctionnement de l'ensemble du dispositif. Garantissez sa cohérence globale : veillez à l'articulation entre les référentiels, les parcours de référencement, les services techniques et le fonctionnement opérationnel. Coordonnez les différents chantier

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One , Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite. XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran. This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. Concevoir et développer un outil capable de générer automatiquement : Les classes associées à la partie graphique du logiciel superviseur. Les classes d'interface assurant la communication entre la partie graphique et le cœur du logiciel. Les classes d'implémentation de ces interfaces dans le cœur du logiciel. Tester et valider la solution développée, puis évaluer son intégration dans l'environnement de développement existant. jobs.title: Stage: Évaluation et intégration d’algorithmes de détection et suivi d’objets par deep learning (F/H)
jobs.description: Nous recherchons un stagiaire pour évaluer et intégrer des algorithmes de détection et de suivi d’objets basés sur le deep learning (F/H) pour une durée de 6 mois à partir du 1er trimestre 2027 au sein de la division Land & Sea sur le site d’Angoulême. Contexte : Les algorithmes de détection et de suivi basés sur l’apprentissage profond évoluent vite, et leurs performances annoncées se transposent mal à de nouveaux capteurs ou de nouvelles conditions. Notre équipe développe des solutions de vision temps réel et dispose d’une bibliothèque modulaire de pipelines de traitement (C++). Il manque une méthode fiable pour comparer les approches et choisir celles à intégrer. Objectif : Mettre en place une plateforme d’évaluation reproductible, puis intégrer les solutions les plus pertinentes dans la bibliothèque. Missions : Reprise de l’existant. Analyser le module actuel de détection et de suivi, diagnostiquer ses limites de généralisation sur d’autres capteurs et en rendre compte. Données et protocole d’évaluation. Constituer des jeux de données infrarouges et visibles, avec découpage par séquence, tests inter-datasets et métriques normalisées (mAP, HOTA, IDF1, vitesse d’exécution). Benchmark de l’état de l’art. Comparer des détecteurs et des trackers récents, avec entraînement ou fine-tuning, augmentation de données et résultats reproductibles. Intégration. Intégrer les solutions retenues dans la bibliothèque C++ et réaliser des démonstrations. Documentation. Rédiger un guide de décision par cas d’usage et la documentation technique. Profil: Étudiant en informatique spécialisé intelligence artificielle / vision par ordinateur / génie logiciel avec : Python et PyTorch, et de bonnes bases en deep learning et en évaluation de modèles ; C++ et de CMake ; De la rigueur, de l’autonomie et un esprit critique argumenté. jobs.title: Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
jobs.description: De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: At Luscii, we're creating space for care by developing and improving digital healthcare applications that make a real difference in people's lives through several applications. From Luscii Thuismeten, which helps healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, to OMRON Connect, connecting millions of people with their health data through OMRON devices, and other applications that expand the possibilities of digital healthcare. Together with healthcare professionals and partners around the world, we're working towards a future where people receive the right care in the right place. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll help shape and modernise the cloud infrastructure behind these applications, building a reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide. Our applications have different histories, architectures and technical challenges. OMRON Connect, for example, runs on an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Parts of its infrastructure still carry legacy, including manual processes, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make changes slower and riskier than they should be. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen. Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Wat bieden wij jou? Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME) Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk Vakantiegeld 8% CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00 Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities Wat ga je doen: Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley. Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel) Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitend

jobs.title: Senior Business Consultant
jobs.description: Over Ockto Ockto is een Nederlandse SaaS-scale-up die organisaties helpt om complexe financiële en administratieve processen slimmer, sneller en volledig digitaal te maken. Met ons platform kunnen consumenten veilig en eenvoudig hun persoonlijke en financiële gegevens delen, rechtstreeks vanuit betrouwbare bronnen. Maar Ockto gaat verder dan alleen het verzamelen en delen van gegevens. We combineren, structureren, valideren en verrijken data tot complete, betrouwbare en direct bruikbare datasets. Hiermee helpen we organisaties om processen verder te automatiseren, betere beslissingen te nemen en aanvragen zoveel mogelijk volledig automatisch af te handelen (Straight Through Processing). With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs. What are you going to do? Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack. Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools. Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics. jobs.description: The role HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group s cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team. What you’ll do Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets. Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions. Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities. Report progress against the group s ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.   You are... An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership. Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.

Viele Kundinnen und Kunden nutzen dafür unseren Service und unser Abo Simplyright+. Wenn dabei einmal etwas schiefläuft, soll sich sofort ein Mensch persönlich darum kümmern. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Deine Aufgaben Du kümmerst dich ausschließlich um unzufriedene Kundinnen und Kunden. Das ist deine einzige Aufgabe. Du rufst Kunden mit einer Beschwerde schnell zurück, hörst zu und verstehst, was wirklich passiert ist. Du bringst Ruhe in angespannte Gespräche und findest gemeinsam mit dem Kunden eine faire Lösung. Du klärst offene Fragen intern mit unserem Team, zum Beispiel zu Abo, Kündigung, Rückerstattung oder Inkasso-Schreiben, und meldest dich verlässlich beim Kunden zurück. Du dokumentierst jeden Fall sauber in unserem Ticketsystem (Zendesk) und antwortest auch per E-Mail. Dein Ziel: Aus einem verärgerten Kunden wird ein zufriedener Kunde. Das bringst du mit Viel Einfühlungsvermögen und Geduld. Du bleibst ruhig, auch wenn es am Telefon mal laut wird. Gutes Deutsch für Telefongespräche. Ein Akzent ist überhaupt kein Problem, perfektes Deutsch brauchst du nicht. Du bist zuverlässig, denkst mit und hältst, was du versprichst. Idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement oder Callcenter. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Gespür sind ebenfalls willkommen. Ein ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, PC oder Laptop und ein Headset. Wichtig – Arbeitsmittel: Ein Windows-Laptop oder Windows-PC sowie ein Headset werden nicht vom Arbeitgeber gestellt. Du bringst beides selbst mit und nutzt es für deine Arbeit. Das bieten wir 2.500 € Gehalt pro Monat. Arbeitszeiten: Montag - Freitag von 08:30 - 17:00 Uhr. 100 % Remote: Du arbeitest von überall auf der Welt. Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, Start ab sofort. Eine gründliche Einarbeitung in unsere Produkte und Abläufe. Kurze Wege ins Team und direkt zur Geschäftsführung. Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn: Du hilfst Menschen

jobs.title: Senior System Administrator
jobs.description: About the Role Join a two-person IT operations team at a SaaS company, maintaining the systems and infrastructure that support day-to-day business operations. You will help ensure reliable, secure services across a heterogeneous environment. What You'll Do Administer and maintain servers, networks, and storage across Windows and Linux environments. Maintain core infrastructure, including Proxmox, Kubernetes, CEPH, and networking systems. Install, configure, and support hardware and software. Monitor system performance, availability, and security, and troubleshoot incidents. Plan and deliver IT projects. Support implementation of ISO 27001 and C5 compliance requirements. What We're Looking For Completed vocational training or a degree in computer science, or a comparable qualification. At least 3 years of experience in system administration or a related role managing servers, networks, and storage. Production experience with virtualization, particularly Proxmox. Experience administering Windows and Linux systems, with solid knowledge of server administration, networking, and IT security. Experience with Microsoft 365 and cloud services such as Azure in hybrid environments. German proficiency at C1 level and English proficiency at B2 level. Experience with Kubernetes, CEPH, procurement, supplier management, or ISO 27001/C5 compliance is beneficial. Compensation & Benefits Visa sponsorship is not available. Benefits include flexible working hours, home office options, professional development support, and health and mobility benefits. Location On-site in Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany. jobs.description: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. SPACE SYSTEMS At Rocket Lab, we're not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more. Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions. DIRECTOR - BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, SPACE SYSTEMS Based in Munich, Germany , as the Director - Business Development , you will drive Rocket Lab's growth in the European satellite market, with a primary focus on Germany and strategic opportunities across Europe. You will work with a range of customers, including government, defense, civil space, commercial, and prime contractor organizations, with a particular focus on national security and sovereign European space capabilities. Your role will involve identifying and engaging with potential clients, developing strategic partnerships, and leading efforts to secure contracts that expand our market share in this rapidly growing sector. jobs.title: Laser Architect (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply. We are seeking a Laser Architect to join our dynamic laser development team. The Laser Architect is the system‑level technical lead responsible for the conceptual design, modeling, and experimental validation of laser driver architectures for inertial fusion energy (IFE) at the research and pre‑pilot stage. This role focuses on defining and evolving credible laser driver concepts that can ultimately support fusion energy production, while operating primarily at the R&D and demonstrator level, where performance exploration, risk reduction, and physics‑driven trade studies dominate over industrial optimization. The Laser Architect ensures coherence between laser physics, system architecture, and fusion requirements, guiding the transition from laboratory concepts toward scalable driver solutions. They enable the transition of inertial fusion energy from proof‑of‑principle laser experiments toward credible, scalable driver concepts, shaping the technical foundations on which future pilot plants and commercial systems will be built. What you'll do: Define and refine laser driver concepts suitable for IFE. Explore alternative architectures and assess their feasibility through modeling and experiments. Maintain ownership of the global architectural vision, even as individual subsystems evolve in parallel. Define the laser R&D roadmap, including critical component development/evaluation, integrated beamline demonstrators, and intermediate testbeds Work closely with experimental teams to ensure results feed back into architectural decisions Support design of diagnostics and test protocols aligned with future scaling needs. Our customers use it to quote PCBAs faster, find cost savings and act on risks in their supply chain. jobs.title: UX Research Intern
jobs.description: About baesh baesh is a social platform connecting people in real life through events, communities, and shared interests. We’re a small team using AI to move quickly from ideas to working experiences. Research is central to how we decide what to build and whether it’s good enough to ship. Your work will help us stay close to people as the technology moves faster. You’ll work closely with our Head of Product and UX , an experienced researcher with a PhD in emotional and behavioural research. You’ll get practical guidance across the research process—from deciding what to investigate to helping the team act on what we learn. This is an unpaid mandatory internship for students whose university programme requires a placement. Location: Mostly remote, with opportunities to join research and events in Berlin. Start date: Flexible, depending on your university requirements. Duration: As required by your university, usually 3–6 months. What you’ll help with Usability testing and idea validation Help plan and run usability tests on our app and prototypes, including interfaces built with AI. Explore how easily people can discover events, join communities, and create their profiles. Test whether experiences make sense to real people, beyond looking polished or functioning technically. Validate early ideas and assumptions before the team invests further. Identify confusing moments and recommend improvements that make a meaningful difference. Exploratory research and interviews Help interview existing users and people who haven’t tried baesh yet. Explore how people make friends, find things to do, and connect with communities. Understand their needs, motivations, habits, and barriers. Help write discussion guides and ask open questions that uncover useful insights. Bring people’s experiences into product decisions, keeping the human connection at the heart of how we build. AI-supported research Use AI to help draft interview guides, usability-testing scripts, and survey questions.

jobs.description: Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock. As Senior Linux Application Engineer (all genders) in our IoT team, you build the software foundation for all our Linux-based devices, on ARM and x86. At its core is a platform layer that unifies shared components such as health monitoring and logging. Every device type then works the same way, and product features build on one solid base. The role combines architecture and hands-on engineering: clean, object-oriented software, plus ownership of how it is built, deployed, updated and monitored across the fleet. Your code sits close to the hardware but runs on top of Linux. Kernel development and microcontroller firmware are not part of the job. If well-designed software for Linux devices is your thing, you’ll feel at home here. As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process. What to expect Unified platform layer: Design and build a platform layer that covers all our device types, both ARM and x86. It provides shared components such as health monitoring, logging, configuration, OTA updates and hardware abstraction. Software architecture: Define clear interfaces between the platform and the applications on top of it. Consolidate the codebase so that new device types and components plug in easily. Application development: Build Python services on top of the platform, inside our dockerized main application. Device integration: Connect peripherals such as modems, watchdogs, cameras and AI accelerators through existing drivers, SDKs and Linux interfaces, behind a clean hardware abstraction. jobs.description: 👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️ At Emidat, we get manufacturers back to manufacturing. Why it matters. Today, only 11% of employees in Germany are engaged at work , and knowledge workers spend 58% of their day on work about work . We want to live in a world where people do work they enjoy and that creates value. A physical world that improves everyday where manufacturers of physical products who build the world around us focus on making better, more sustainable materials. Today, low-value work is often done by people at a company because they’re the only ones who know where the data is - the current data sheet, the hand-issued declaration. EU regulation adds more every year, and when the paperwork is late, the product cannot be sold. International competition and an ageing workforce increase the problem. What we do. Emidat connects to a manufacturer’s own systems and builds one verified record per product and plant. On it runs AI applications that produce the documents: Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), digital product passports, data sheets, tender answers. The experts approve. The software does the typing. Where we are. 250+ manufacturers in 60+ product groups and 25+ countries, among them Holcim, Sika and a long list of mid-sized family companies. We started automating sustainability data for front runners who already wanted to do the right thing - next is everyone else. Who we are. 50+ people in Munich, we run on ownership, action over complaint and low ego. We aim to become better everyday and reinvent ourselves quickly. jobs.title: Vertriebsmitarbeiter im Außendienst (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wir suchen Dich! Wir, die Berndt Mobilitätsprodukte GmbH, gehören zu den führenden unabhängigen Anbietern von Liftsystemen in den östlichen Bundesländern. Seit über 20 Jahren sorgen wir mit individuellen Mobilitätslösungen für mehr Barrierefreiheit und Lebensqualität. Mit über 80 Mitarbeitenden im Innen- und Außendienst sind wir ein stetig wachsendes, inhabergeführtes Unternehmen. Was uns auszeichnet? Kurze Entscheidungswege, ein vertrauensvolles Miteinander und ein starkes Team, das gemeinsam etwas bewegt. Zur Verstärkung unseres Vertriebsteams suchen wir ab sofort einen engagierten Vertriebsmitarbeiter im Außendienst (m/w/d) für die Region Berlin und Brandenburg. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben: Du berätst unsere Kundinnen und Kunden persönlich vor Ort – einfühlsam, kompetent und mit dem Ziel, individuelle Mobilitätslösungen zu finden. Keine Kaltakquise: Deine Kundentermine werden durch unseren Innendienst bereits fest vereinbart und für dich geplant. Du verkaufst überwiegend Treppensitzlifte sowie gelegentlich Plattformlifte, Hublifte und Homelifte. Du ermittelst den individuellen Bedarf, nimmst die örtlichen Gegebenheiten auf und erstellst passende Angebote. Du führst Aufmaße durch und prüfst gemeinsam mit unserem Team die technische Umsetzbarkeit. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Innendienst zusammen und sorgst so für eine reibungslose Auftragsabwicklung. Du bereitest deine Kundentermine eigenständig vor und nach – teilweise flexibel aus dem Homeoffice. Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst schwerpunktmäßig Berlin und Brandenburg. Bei Bedarf übernimmst du auch Kundentermine in angrenzenden Regionen oder vertrittst Kollegen in anderen Vertriebsgebieten. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung – oder überzeugst uns als motivierter Quereinsteiger mit Verkaufstalent. Du hast Freude am Verkauf und ein gutes Gespür für die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unterschiedlicher Menschen. Du trittst selbstbewusst, freundlich und überzeugend

jobs.description: Was wir suchen Eine Person, die ihre Freunde als „technisch-affinen Menschenfreund“ beschreiben würden, und Lust darauf hat zu erklären und zu beraten. Setup: Du richtest KI-Systeme nach unserem festen, dokumentierten Standard ein und verbindest ihn mit den Plattformen des Kunden, zum Beispiel Mail, Kalender und etc. Onboarding: Du begleitest den Kunden, bis alles rund läuft – mit Onboarding-Call und einer Woche Feedback-Runde. Tempo: Nach der Einarbeitung betreust du mehrere Setups parallel und startest bis zu einen neuen Kunden pro Tag. jobs.description: FULL-TIME | 5 DAYS ON-SITE LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK FIELD TRAVEL: AS REQUIRED THE LAST FRONTIER ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk. THE ROLE We’re looking for a Senior Electronics Engineer to design, build, and test all electrical systems within ARD’s product stack. You’ll work at the intersection of hardware, software, and real-world deployment making an impact at every layer – from the PCB to Arctic field tests. You’ll move fast and take end-to-end ownership of the electronic architecture you’ll build, ensuring seamless operation in the harshest climate on Earth. You will be involved at all stages of electronics development and a key member of the engineering team at our early company stage. * Please note: this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship * CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Architect, build, and iterate embedded systems from first principles - including MCUs, PCBs, physical comms modules, and ARD’s custom subsystems Own electrical integration across ARD’s full stack, optimising for SWaP-C at every iteration Serve as the go-to technical lead across electrical, RF, systems, and mechanical interfaces Work tightly with deployment, software, and systems teams to ship field-ready hardware Get hands-on in field – travel to Arctic test site

jobs.title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
jobs.description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale. Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be. AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. jobs.title: Finance Business Partner
jobs.description: About Everfield Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem. Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing. About the Role This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses. You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound. Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies. jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. As a Cloud Engineer, you will operate and support the cloud platforms that power The Exploration Company’s engineering, operations, and data workloads in France. You will design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud services so teams can work securely and reliably across both environments. This hands-on, high-ownership role sits at the intersection of aerospace and modern cloud engineering, with a strong focus on security, sovereignty, and compliance requirements. You will work on-site in France and collaborate closely with engineering teams to translate their needs into resilient, secure, and well-documented infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud environments, including managed Kubernetes, compute, networking, storage, and managed database services. Define and maintain a consistent architecture across AWS and SecNumCloud, including identity, networking, and secrets management, to keep environments comparable and portable where needed. Build and maintain infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) so all environments are reproducible and version-controlled. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate infrastructure and application builds, testing, and deployment. Manage container platforms and orchestration, including Kubernetes cluster upgrades, networking, RBAC, and workload scheduling. Set up and maintain observability (metrics, logging, alerting) to detect and resolve issues before they affect engineering or operations. Enforce security and compliance best practices, including IAM policies, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, key management, and vulnerability patching. Support audits and compliance evidence collection for SecNumCloud and other applicable frameworks. Define backup, retention, and disaster recovery strategies for critical data
